hero.label: How it works
hero.title: From a messy problem to a team, a plan and a better next time.
hero.lead: Three chapters: what GRTA does for a team builder, the HIIT method for urgent problems, and how organisations roll it out person to person.
hero.alt: Nine colleagues in three small groups around a long table, their threads of light meeting above one glowing plan.

journey.label: Chapter 1
journey.title: The journey
journey.lead: Six steps, each one removing a bit of friction between a problem and the people who can solve it.

steps.title: Zero blank page
steps.text: Write a paragraph in plain language. GRTA turns it into a structured brief with roles, competencies and timeline. You review and adjust.

steps.title: Gap detection
steps.text: GRTA compares your brief with similar projects that worked. If you forgot change management or legal, it tells you before anyone is matched.

steps.title: Plain-language translation
steps.text: People describe themselves in their own words. GRTA reads their past work and translates “I turn complexity into clarity” into competencies it can match.

steps.title: Availability first
steps.text: The best match is useless if they're fully booked. Unavailable people are left out or clearly flagged, with the reason.

steps.title: Team variants and the wildcard
steps.text: Choose between an Execution, a Challenger or an Innovation team. Each comes with a coverage map and an explanation. Sometimes there's a wildcard: someone unexpected, with evidence for why they could help.

steps.title: Two-minute pulse
steps.text: When the project ends, five quick questions. GRTA learns which teams actually work in your organisation.

scout.title: Then GRTA starts looking ahead.
scout.text: With enough history, GRTA moves from answering to suggesting.

items.title: Skills surplus
items.text: Spots clusters of talent that are under-used and suggests where they could make a difference.

items.title: Skills gap alerts
items.text: Holds your strategy against the competencies you actually have, so you know early what to build or hire.

items.title: Cross-silo opportunities
items.text: Introduces people in different departments whose work fits together, before anyone asked.

method.label: Chapter 2
method.title: The HIIT Engine: 9 → 3 → 1
method.lead: For urgent, high-stakes questions. High-intensity, time-boxed, and built to end in action.

phases.title: Describe the problem
phases.text: One prompt. GRTA finds 9 complementary competencies across the organisation.

phases.title: Experts prepare
phases.text: Each expert prepares a 20×20 presentation with AI help: 20 slides, 20 seconds each.

phases.title: 3 parallel HIIT meetings
phases.text: Three experts per room present, reflect and agree an action plan.

phases.title: 1 joint meeting
phases.text: AI turns each plan into a 20×20 summary. Together, the group sets priorities and agrees one execution plan.

method.flowText: Nine perspectives meet in three small rooms at the same time. Each room agrees what matters. Then everything comes together in one plan, with owners and deadlines.

hero.label: About
hero.title: AI connects data. GRTA connects people.
hero.lead: We believe the best answers already exist inside your organisation. They're just spread across people who haven't met yet.

equation.title: AI + BI + CI = DI
equation.text: Artificial Intelligence and Business Intelligence are only half the picture. Add the Collective Intelligence of your people and you get Decision Intelligence: better decisions, made faster, by the right people.

story.title: Why GRTA exists
paragraphs: Every organisation has a moment when something important lands on someone's desk and they ask: who here can help? Too often, the answer is a guess, a favour, or whoever happens to be free.

GRTA started as a way to find people and competencies. It has grown into a full model for understanding what people can really do, finding perspectives that complement each other, assembling teams, and turning Collective Intelligence into decisions and action.
We keep one rule: people before technology. The AI does the searching, structuring and remembering. People do the deciding.

items.title: The right people
items.text: Not the most senior, not the most available. The ones who see the problem from the right angle.

items.title: The right perspectives
items.text: Complementary beats similar. Friction, used well, makes better decisions.

items.title: At the right time
items.text: Structured, time-boxed, action-oriented. Hours, not months.

together.title: Be GRTA together.
together.alt: The six recurring characters walking side by side along a calm Nordic waterfront, loosely linked by threads of light.

items.title: Your organisation owns its data
items.text: Profiles, projects and outcomes belong to you. You can export or delete them at any time.

items.title: Hosted in the EU
items.text: Data is stored and processed in the EU. Sub-processors are listed and bound by data processing agreements.

items.title: No training on your data
items.text: Your data is never used to train shared AI models. AI providers process requests without retaining them.

items.title: Explainable by design
items.text: Every match and suggestion shows the reasons behind it, so people can question it.

items.title: People stay in control
items.text: Employees see and edit their own profile, and choose what is visible to whom.

items.title: Security basics, done properly
items.text: Encryption in transit and at rest, single sign-on, role-based access and audit logs.
